facts.value: Receives Suicune's Item_GObj from the floor-contact path and obtains its Item for audio. It requests Camera_RequestQuake(QuakeKind_Large, NULL), plays sound 0x9 with arguments 0x7F and 0x40, forwards the object to it_80273454 to reset velocity, and calls it_802CFD3C. That initializer enters state 0 with ITEM_ANIM_UPDATE, installs effect-hitlag and accessory callbacks, and copies the Pokémon timer from special attributes.
